//: Typecheck project for scripts/**/*.ts (#3905). Before this existed, no project reference included scripts/, so `tsc -b` passed vacuously for every .ts file there — a review of #3804 found 6 real type errors under the repo's own strict options that this gate said nothing about (fixed in #3804/#3906; this project is the gap that hid them). REFERENCED from tsconfig.json, deliberately, per the same rule the other project tsconfigs state: a project outside the reference list is a project nothing checks. Scoped to `.ts` only — scripts/ also holds .mjs (plain JS, run directly by node/vitest, not type-checked anywhere else in the repo either) and .py/.sh (out of tsc's domain entirely); pulling those in is a separate decision, not silently bundled into this one. noEmit keeps this out of any build output.
